title: Azifa Stuffed Cherry Tomatoes
description: A simple and flavorful dish combining the sweetness of cherry tomatoes with the savory flavor of azifa.

ingredients.name: hearty bread
ingredients.notes: crust removed and torn into small pieces

instructions: Cut the tops off the cherry tomatoes and scoop out the insides, leaving a shell.
In a bowl, mix together azifa, torn bread, olive oil, and cumin.
Fill each tomato shell with the azifa mixture.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Place the stuffed tomatoes on a baking sheet and bake for 15-20 minutes, or until the tomatoes are tender.
